about: P83C T8: the 10 sentences of the second sealed set (evals/play/p83/c-sentences.json → sealed2, written by a separate agent before T7, read for the first time here, after the T7 fixes). Quick game without a model (draftGameSpecWithMeta(text, 1)), production build of 30bdfd2d, next start :3213, desktop 1280x720 Chromium d3d11. Game started by one click on empty ground at the left edge, shot A after 5 s, then three clicks on things (orrery: on the things from data-orrery-things; other games: stage centre), shot B. Blind judge: codex exec -i sheet.png in an empty mkdtemp dir, contract task.md + output schema, one at a time, web search off, reasoning effort high.

rows.text: show me the bones of a human skeleton and each bone shows its name when clicked

judge.seen: A grassy collection game with scattered bone icons, a large upright bone, a timer, and the instruction “Collect the bones!”
judge.reason: Panel A lacks a recognizable human skeleton or bone names. Panel B adds a visible glowing ring beneath a bone in the middle distance.

rows.text: a space station with an astronaut, a satellite dish, solar panels and a supply capsule, each one glows when you tap it

judge.seen: Panel A shows labeled astronaut, satellite dish, solar panel and supply capsule on reddish ground, with an explored counter at 0/4.
judge.reason: All named objects are recognizable through shapes and labels. Panel B adds yellow glows around three objects and increases the explored counter to 3/4.

rows.text: a giant computer keyboard, click any key and it grows bigger so you can read the letter

judge.seen: Five scattered physical keys labeled “Key” on a brown surface, with an explored counter; no computer keyboard or lettered keyboard keys.
judge.reason: Panel A lacks the requested computer keyboard. Panel B highlights three keys with yellow rings and labels, and the explored counter increases from 0/5 to 3/5.

rows.text: explore a pirate ship where the captain, the parrot, the treasure chest and the anchor show their names when you tap them

judge.seen: Panel A shows a boat in a sandy arena collecting coins, with a countdown and collection objective; the requested pirate characters and objects are missing.
judge.reason: The scene is generic coin-collection gameplay. Panel B shows no clear click-triggered response; timer and coin changes could occur automatically.

rows.text: a bakery window with a croissant, a loaf of bread, a pretzel and a cake, touch one and it puffs up

judge.seen: A collection game on a large tiled floor, with a central brown character, scattered croissants, bakery counters, and a countdown timer.
judge.reason: A lacks the requested bakery-window arrangement and most named baked goods. B shows no clear click response; the timer and minor scene changes could occur automatically.

rows.text: a windy hill with windmills turning slowly, tap a windmill and its blades spin faster

judge.seen: A horse stands in a grassy orchard with scattered glowing collectibles, a “Windmill” label, and a “Collect the windmills!” objective.
judge.reason: The scene shows generic collection gameplay rather than a windy hill with turning windmills. B shows no clear click-triggered response or evidence of faster blades.

rows.text: let me look inside a toolbox with a hammer, a wrench, a screwdriver and a saw, touch each tool to see its name

judge.seen: Panel A shows labeled hammer, wrench, screwdriver, and saw on a blue surface, plus a yellow object and an explored 0/5 counter.
judge.reason: All four requested tools are identifiable by their labels. Panel B adds yellow highlights and increases the explored counter from 0/5 to 3/5.

rows.text: hot air balloons drifting over a valley, when you tap a balloon it inflates and grows

judge.seen: A runner character travels along a forest track with obstacles, collectibles, a timer, and a finish-line distance indicator.
judge.reason: A shows a runner game, not balloons drifting over a valley. B visibly changes to a game-over dialog showing all three lives lost.

rows.text: a harbor at night with a lighthouse, a fishing boat and a sailboat, touch them and they shine

judge.seen: A dark blue nighttime harbor scene with labeled lighthouse, fishing boat, and sailboat; the exploration counter reads 0/3.
judge.reason: Panel A includes all three named objects in a nighttime water setting. Panel B visibly changes to a completion screen reporting all three explored and 565 points.

rows.text: an airport with little planes circling the control tower, click a plane to make it fly faster

judge.seen: Four little planes surround a labeled control tower on concentric circular paths, with an explored counter at 0/5.
judge.reason: The planes and central control tower match the requested arrangement. Panel B adds yellow highlights to three planes and increases the explored counter to 3/5.
